findings_addressed.oracle: Independent oracle: _build_pe_binary() in conftest.py writes b'MZ' at offset 0 (0x4D=77, 0x5A=90) and struct.pack_into('<H', data, 2, 0x0090) which stores 0x90 at offset 2. These three byte values are hand-decoded from the fixture builder, not from the search result itself. The pattern '4D ?? 90' must match at offset 0 with length 3 by the wildcard-mask algebra in search.rs search_masked_single().
